summary: A new Delta Air Lines computer problem is delaying many flights today. The FAA reportedly says it is not tied to air traffic systems. The FBI crime database break-in and the USDA incident are still unexplained. No official source links any of them.

events.title: Delta Air Lines outage delays flights across the US
events.impact: One travel site says up to 3,500 Delta flights were delayed today. I could not check the number myself. FAA's own airport feed shows only weather and volume delays.
events.stated_cause: Delta is working on its weight and balance automation system, per an FAA post quoted by one site. The FAA said the delays are not related to FAA air traffic systems. No cyber cause reported.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC for warrant and missing-person checks. Reports do not say if it went down or if records were taken or changed. A retired agent warned that altered records could be a risk.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI had not commented as of Saturday. Reports rely on unnamed sources. Nothing links it to the September ShinyHunters jobs-portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident disrupts farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation tools were down for days. An official expected most systems back Friday, with work over the weekend. He said no personal data was lost. I found no newer update today.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat. Staff reset database passwords. No attacker named and no account of how it happened.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Hormuz at highest level of the conflict
events.impact: Projectiles hit three tankers Friday and Saturday, per a maritime risk firm. Iran says more tankers hit mines. The US is blockading Iranian ports and escorting tankers.
events.stated_cause: Nobody has officially claimed the projectile hits. The risk firm says Iranian involvement is likely. Iran says it controls the strait and its mine claims are mostly unverified.

events.title: US stocks sold off hard Friday; markets closed until Monday
events.impact: Friday close: Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.28%). S&P 500 and Dow are in a correction. Nvidia fell about 14% on Friday. No Sunday futures data found yet. No trading halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI worries and a Reuters report that the SEC is reviewing Nvidia accounting. The SEC declined comment. No technical fault or cyber attack reported.

events.title: Bitcoin steady near 60K USD after a week of losses
events.impact: Price check: CoinGecko 60,612, Coinbase 60,172, Bitget 60,181. Prices agree and are up about 1-3% in 24h, down about 6% in 7 days. Some pages show old prices (for example Binance near 79.7K). No crash and no exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. The drop follows the stock selloff and crypto selling.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive. Federal agencies must fix them.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 01:11 UTC Nov 22. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Microsoft explains Nov 12 global Microsoft 365 outage
events.impact: Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams and Copilot were disrupted for almost 24 hours. Microsoft gave its full cause on Saturday.
events.stated_cause: Microsoft says a months-old software bug was triggered after Teams traffic moved to servers with less capacity. It says it was not a cyberattack. No outside source disputes this.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI database break-in and the USDA incident both have unknown causes, and no one has named an attacker. The Delta problem is blamed on its own weight and balance system, and the FAA says air traffic systems are not involved. Stocks are falling on AI worries, and Hormuz is a war. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No confirmed link between incidents. The new Delta outage has a stated company cause and is not confirmed by a second source.

prep_note: If you fly on Delta today, check your flight status and allow extra time. Police, farm-loan and payment services may still be slow. Keep some cash and a backup way to pay. Monday's stock open may be volatile, so avoid rushed money moves.
